A Useful Test Article

By Ian Example

This is the opening paragraph of a deliberately plain article fixture. It has enough meaningful prose to make a readability parser treat it like article content rather than navigation chrome.

The extractor should keep article paragraphs, remove surrounding page furniture, and return both HTML and normalized text that the Elixir app can store for later summarization, filtering, or RSS rendering.

A third paragraph gives the quality heuristic enough length to pass in tests while still staying small enough for future maintainers to understand quickly.

Related links and newsletter widgets should not be part of the result.
